title: Arizona Clay Space Residency
source_quote: The Residency is coming. We are not accepting applications yet, but the program is taking shape.
evidence_sentence: Residency includes access to wood kilns and residents participate in community labor including kiln maintenance and wood processing.
evidence_quote: Access to All Kilns: Electric, Gas & Wood
summary: Full-immersion one-to-three-year residency for committed ceramic artists in northern Arizona with private studio, on-site housing, and access to electric, gas, and wood kilns. 20 hours/week studio time plus 5 hours/week community labor required. Applications opening soon.
commitment: 1 Year Minimum, 3 Years Maximum; 20 Hours/Week studio time, 5 Hours/Week community labor
cost_text: Work Exchange and No-work Exchange rental rates; price info coming soon. Clay, glaze, firing fuel, and kiln rental fees are resident's responsibility.
how_to_join: Reach out directly via contact page or email; applications open once a year depending on availability.
